title: Fair Warning to Auction Major Yoshitomo Nara Painting for Up to $15 M.

title: French Museum’s ‘Wanted’ Poster Campaign for Stolen Art Leads to Return of Missing 17th-Century Dutch Painting

summary: “Even my most schematic sculptures, without entirely abandoning the figurative, always bear the marks of man,” the artist once said of his “Cities.”
